ruins.name: Ruins of St. Paul's
ruins.price_text: Free to view the facade; check on the day for any museum fee
ruins.hours: Usually daytime and early evening; check on the day
ruins.tip: Climb the steps from the back of the square and see the facade from below first.
ruins.best: Early morning before the crowds, or dusk for photos

senado.name: Senado Square
senado.hours: Open all day and into the evening
senado.tip: Wander the black-and-white wave pattern paving and stop at the cafés on the edges.

guia.name: Guia Fortress
guia.price_text: Check on the day; small fee possible for the chapel and lighthouse
guia.hours: Usually daytime; check on the day
guia.tip: Walk up from the Guia Chapel and stay for the views over the city and the Pearl River mouth.

ama.name: A-Ma Temple
ama.hours: Usually daytime and early evening; check on the day
ama.tip: Visit on a weekday if you can; the hill steps and incense smoke can be crowded at weekends.

tower.name: Macau Tower
tower.price_text: Check on the day; ticket tiers include observation deck and skywalk
tower.hours: Usually daytime to late evening; check on the day
tower.tip: Book the observation deck for sunset and watch the city lights come on.

ocean.name: Chimelong Ocean Kingdom
ocean.price_text: Check on the day; prices vary by ticket type
ocean.hours: Usually daytime to evening; check on the day
ocean.tip: This park is in Hengqin, across the border in mainland China, so check transport and border rules before you go.

grand_lisboa.name: Grand Lisboa
grand_lisboa.price_text: Free to walk through the lobby and casino floor
grand_lisboa.hours: Open 24 hours; check on the day for specific areas
grand_lisboa.tip: Look at the golden lotus-shaped tower from the street, then go inside to see the lobby and gaming floors.

jiuzhouyang.name: Jiuzhouyang
jiuzhouyang.tip: Details for this place were not verified, so confirm opening times and entry rules before you go.

lionsgate.name: Lionsgate Entertainment World
lionsgate.price_text: Check on the day; shows and attractions are sold separately
lionsgate.hours: Usually daytime to late evening; check on the day
lionsgate.tip: Check the show schedule online and book ahead, since performances can sell out.

aqua.name: Macau Aqua World
aqua.tip: A good option for a rainy day with children; check the feeding and show times when you arrive.

red_market.name: Mercado Vermelho
red_market.price_text: Food prices vary; check on the day
red_market.hours: Usually morning to early afternoon; check on the day
red_market.tip: Go early for fresh produce and local snacks, and bring cash for small stalls.

morpheus.name: Morpheus
morpheus.price_text: Check on the day; hotel and attraction access may differ
morpheus.tip: Check whether this is open to visitors without a hotel booking before you plan your visit.

taipa_houses.name: Taipa Houses
taipa_houses.price_text: Check on the day; small entry fee possible
taipa_houses.hours: Usually daytime, closed one day a week; check on the day
taipa_houses.tip: Combine this with a stroll through Taipa Village to see Portuguese-style colonial architecture.

taipa_market.name: Taipa Village Street Market
taipa_market.price_text: Food prices vary; check on the day
taipa_market.hours: Usually evening; check on the day
taipa_market.tip: Try the Macanese snacks and almond cookies, and ask for small portions to taste more.

rua_cunha.name: Rua do Cunha
rua_cunha.price_text: Food prices vary; check on the day
rua_cunha.hours: Shops and cafés usually open daytime; check on the day
rua_cunha.tip: Stop for Portuguese egg tarts and Macanese dishes on this colourful lane in Taipa.

lou_lim_ioc.name: Lou Lim Ioc Garden
lou_lim_ioc.hours: Usually daytime; check on the day
lou_lim_ioc.tip: A quiet classical Chinese garden with ponds and bridges, good for a break from the crowds.

penha_hill.name: Penha Hill viewpoint
penha_hill.hours: Usually daytime; check on the day
penha_hill.tip: Walk up near Penha Church for wide views over the old town and the Outer Harbour.

senado_food_walk.name: Senado food walking tour
senado_food_walk.price_text: Check on the day; guided tours vary in price
senado_food_walk.hours: Usually one to three hours; check on the day
senado_food_walk.tip: A guided walk through the old town tastes Macanese and Portuguese dishes and explains the history.
